title: Elf Bar 600 Mix Berries Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Mix Berries Prefilled Pods are made for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, bringing a rich, fruit-led vape in a fuss-free format. Each pack comes with two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, each lasting up to 600 puffs depending on usage. With inhale activation, they deliver a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw that’s both easy to use and satisfying, without the need for refills or maintenance. The flavour blends an assortment of juicy berry notes, combining sweet and tangy tones for a rounded fruit vape that tastes vibrant and full of character. Balanced for all-day enjoyment, it’s a flavour that stays consistent from first puff to last. Replacing pods is quick and mess-free — just click in a fresh pod when needed.
